s0301.literal: Grand councillors Susu and Mingli Dong'a were both put in charge of Stored Blessings Office affairs; falconry commissioner Sali and Henan Branch Secretariat left vice chancellor Yao Wei were both made superintendents of Stored Blessings; marshal Yesu Taier seized Prince of Xiangning Bala Siri and sent him to the capital.
s0301.idiomatic: Grand councillors Susu and Mingli Dong'a were both put in charge of Stored Blessings Office affairs; falconry commissioner Sali and Henan Branch Secretariat left vice chancellor Yao Wei were both made superintendents of Stored Blessings; marshal Yesu Taier seized Prince of Xiangning Bala Siri and sent him to the capital.

s0302.literal: Bala Siri, together with Prince of Zhao Mazahan and Prince Hulatai, obeying Shangdu's command, each raised their following troops to invade south into Jining; on returning and halting at Mayi they were thereupon seized; the men and women they had captured, one thousand in all, were all returned to their homes.
s0302.idiomatic: Bala Siri, together with Prince of Zhao Mazahan and Prince Hulatai, obeying Shangdu's command, each raised their following troops to invade south into Jining; on returning and halting at Mayi they were thereupon seized; the men and women they had captured, 1,000 in all, were all returned to their homes.

s0303.literal: Envoys were dispatched to stop Jiang-Zhe troops going to Tong Pass, ordering them to return to their garrisons.
s0303.idiomatic: Envoys were dispatched to stop Jiang-Zhe troops going to Tong Pass, ordering them to return to their garrisons.

s0304.literal: Yesi Temür's troops reached Lu Prefecture.
s0304.idiomatic: Yesi Temür's troops reached Lu Prefecture.

s0305.literal: On yimao day Doresh's residence was granted to Buqa Temür; Doresh's son Popi's residence was granted to Ordoman; inner attendant Wang Bayan's residence was granted to Tangqishi.
s0305.idiomatic: On yimao day Doresh's residence was granted to Buqa Temür; Doresh's son Popi's residence was granted to Ordoman; inner attendant Wang Bayan's residence was granted to Tangqishi.

s0306.literal: On bingchen day Yan Temür requested that confiscated property of the traitor Chiqin Temür be returned to his wife.
s0306.idiomatic: On bingchen day Yan Temür requested that confiscated property of the traitor Chiqin Temür be returned to his wife.

s0308.literal: On dingsi day the chamber of Emperor Xianzong was destroyed; Emperor Shunzong was installed in the second chamber on the right of Mu; Emperor Chengzong in the third chamber on the right of Mu; Emperor Wuzong in the third chamber on the left of Zhao; Emperor Renzong in the fourth chamber on the left of Zhao; Emperor Yingzong in the fourth chamber on the right of Mu.
s0308.idiomatic: On dingsi day the chamber of Emperor Xianzong was destroyed; Emperor Shunzong was installed in the second chamber on the right of Mu; Emperor Chengzong in the third chamber on the right of Mu; Emperor Wuzong in the third chamber on the left of Zhao; Emperor Renzong in the fourth chamber on the left of Zhao; Emperor Yingzong in the fourth chamber on the right of Mu.

s0309.literal: Yan Temür was additionally granted the title Daraqan, and his descendants were still ordered to inherit the title in perpetuity.
s0309.idiomatic: Yan Temür was additionally granted the title Daraqan, and his descendants were still ordered to inherit the title in perpetuity.

s0310.literal: Yan Temür requested that the fields and houses of twenty-three persons including Qole of Henan be granted to twenty-three persons including Prince of Xi'an Alaqtenashiri — approved.
s0310.idiomatic: Yan Temür requested that the fields and houses of 23 persons including Qole of Henan be granted to 23 persons including Prince of Xi'an Alaqtenashiri — approved.

s0311.literal: On wuwu day an edict instructed the court: "Among today's officials, only Grand Councillor Yan Temür and Grand Preceptor Bayan may concurrently hold three posts and manage affairs; the rest should all be simplified.
s0311.idiomatic: On wuwu day an edict instructed the court: "Among today's officials, only Grand Councillor Yan Temür and Grand Preceptor Bayan may concurrently hold three posts and manage affairs; the rest should all be simplified.

s0312.literal: Matters of the hundred offices that should be memorialized should be jointly deliberated and reported; those who privately follow their own wishes may not memorialize alone.
s0312.idiomatic: Matters of the hundred offices that should be memorialized should be jointly deliberated and reported; those who privately follow their own wishes may not memorialize alone.

s0313.literal: Shangdu officials appointed after the twenty-first day of the eighth month — all their commissions should be revoked."
s0313.idiomatic: Shangdu officials appointed after the twenty-first day of the eighth month — all their commissions should be revoked."

s0314.literal: An edict: "Buddhist and Daoist monks throughout the realm who have wives — all are ordered to become commoners."
s0314.idiomatic: An edict: "Buddhist and Daoist monks throughout the realm who have wives — all are ordered to become commoners."

s0316.literal: Guangping and Daming routes were ordered to requisition horses.
s0316.idiomatic: Guangping and Daming routes were ordered to requisition horses.

s0318.literal: Initially, Buqa, taking advantage of the realm's many troubles, led his following in plundering; all north of Juyong was disturbed by them; at this time thieves entered his home and killed him.
s0318.idiomatic: Initially, Buqa, taking advantage of the realm's many troubles, led his following in plundering; all north of Juyong was disturbed by them; at this time thieves entered his home and killed him.

s0319.literal: Xinghe Route treated the thieves with capital punishment; the Ministry of Justice deliberated: "Buqa was without the Way; all knew of it; fortunately meeting with thieves' murder, yet this route concealed his crimes of remnant plunder and reported only the theft — this is improper under the law."
s0319.idiomatic: Xinghe Route treated the thieves with capital punishment; the Ministry of Justice deliberated: "Buqa was without the Way; all knew of it; fortunately meeting with thieves' murder, yet this route concealed his crimes of remnant plunder and reported only the theft — this is improper under the law."

s0320.literal: The central secretariat reported; the Emperor commended their deliberation.
s0320.idiomatic: The central secretariat reported; the Emperor commended their deliberation.

s0321.literal: Eleventh month, on jiwei day an edict instructed the court and countryside: "Princes Wang Chan and Tumen Dayar, Alabuqa, Tuqan, and others, defeated in battle and fled — whoever can capture them shall be granted a fifth-rank office;
s0321.idiomatic: Eleventh month, on jiwei day an edict instructed the court and countryside: "Princes Wang Chan and Tumen Dayar, Alabuqa, Tuqan, and others, defeated in battle and fled — whoever can capture them shall be granted a fifth-rank office;

s0322.literal: Fellow partisans who can abandon rebellion and submit, capture Wang Chan and others and come to submit — their original guilt is remitted, and offices granted as above;
s0322.idiomatic: Fellow partisans who can abandon rebellion and submit, capture Wang Chan and others and come to submit — their original guilt is remitted, and offices granted as above;

s0323.literal: Household slaves who capture them may serve in the palace guard;
s0323.idiomatic: Household slaves who capture them may serve in the palace guard;

s0324.literal: Whoever dares conceal them — when the matter is discovered, guilt equal to the criminal."
s0324.idiomatic: Whoever dares conceal them — when the matter is discovered, guilt equal to the criminal."

s0325.literal: The surveillance censor's seal and Jining Route seal were granted; as for seals of the hundred offices within and without lost due to warfare, the central secretariat was ordered to cast and grant them according to rank.
s0325.idiomatic: The surveillance censor's seal and Jining Route seal were granted; as for seals of the hundred offices within and without lost due to warfare, the central secretariat was ordered to cast and grant them according to rank.

s0326.literal: Grand preceptor Badashah was promoted to grand tutor and concurrently made jarquchi of the Imperial Clan Court, commanding troops on the northern frontier.
s0326.idiomatic: Grand preceptor Badashah was promoted to grand tutor and concurrently made jarquchi of the Imperial Clan Court, commanding troops on the northern frontier.

s0327.literal: Central secretariat officials said: "Supervising censor Zuoji lacks talent and should not bear the post of wind discipline."
s0327.idiomatic: Central secretariat officials said: "Supervising censor Zuoji lacks talent and should not bear the post of wind discipline."

s0328.literal: Censorate officials Bayan and others said: "Zuoji was recommended by the censorate; if having already used him, one then stops on others' word, the censorate's authority cannot be upheld.
s0328.idiomatic: Censorate officials Bayan and others said: "Zuoji was recommended by the censorate; if having already used him, one then stops on others' word, the censorate's authority cannot be upheld.

s0329.literal: If it must be as the central secretariat officials say, we beg to resign and withdraw."
s0329.idiomatic: If it must be as the central secretariat officials say, we beg to resign and withdraw."

s0330.literal: The Emperor said: "You all must not speak thus.
s0330.idiomatic: The Emperor said: "You all must not speak thus.

s0331.literal: If Zuoji is truly unusable, why did the central secretariat officials not speak first.
s0331.idiomatic: If Zuoji is truly unusable, why did the central secretariat officials not speak first.

s0333.literal: The Emperor said to central secretariat officials: "When I was at Qiong Prefecture and Jiankang, Sadi always followed and endured utmost hardship; grant him sixty thousand salt certificates so he may seek profit to support his household."
s0333.idiomatic: The Emperor said to central secretariat officials: "When I was at Qiong Prefecture and Jiankang, Sadi always followed and endured utmost hardship; grant him 60,000 salt certificates so he may seek profit to support his household."

s0334.literal: Prefectures and counties were ordered to gather people who had fled due to warfare; the poor were granted relief.
s0334.idiomatic: Prefectures and counties were ordered to gather people who had fled due to warfare; the poor were granted relief.

s0335.literal: Surrendered troops of Liaodong were granted marching grain and sent back.
s0335.idiomatic: Surrendered troops of Liaodong were granted marching grain and sent back.

s0336.literal: Commoners of the capital region and the four directions who had been plundered by troops and enslaved by others — the relevant offices were ordered to pursue investigation and send them back.
s0336.idiomatic: Commoners of the capital region and the four directions who had been plundered by troops and enslaved by others — the relevant offices were ordered to pursue investigation and send them back.

s0337.literal: Relay stations in Shannbei and Jingdong that had suffered warfare were relieved with twenty-one thousand five hundred ingots of notes.
s0337.idiomatic: Relay stations in Shannbei and Jingdong that had suffered warfare were relieved with 21,500 ingots of notes.

s0338.literal: Goryeo eunuchs Mixiemi and Ganggadali were released to return to their villages.
s0338.idiomatic: Goryeo eunuchs Mixiemi and Ganggadali were released to return to their villages.

s0339.literal: On gengshen day the central secretariat recorded and employed former censorate officials Elinjin and Cai Wenyuan.
s0339.idiomatic: On gengshen day the central secretariat recorded and employed former censorate officials Elinjin and Cai Wenyuan.

s0340.literal: Following Jiangnan Branch Censorate censor Wang Juren's memorial, recent appointees from commoner status were purged.
s0340.idiomatic: Following Jiangnan Branch Censorate censor Wang Juren's memorial, recent appointees from commoner status were purged.

s0341.literal: The mobile censorate was ordered: "Whatever impeachments there are must be memorialized by the censorate; do not directly report by sealed memorial."
s0341.idiomatic: The mobile censorate was ordered: "Whatever impeachments there are must be memorialized by the censorate; do not directly report by sealed memorial."

s0342.literal: The central secretariat was ordered to pursue recovery of Doresh and his elder brother Ma Mou's, son Popi's, Mubaraqsha's and others' family property.
s0342.idiomatic: The central secretariat was ordered to pursue recovery of Doresh and his elder brother Ma Mou's, son Popi's, Mubaraqsha's and others' family property.

s0343.literal: On xinyou day Yan Temür requested that Niudze's fields and houses be granted to Qincha Tai.
s0343.idiomatic: On xinyou day Yan Temür requested that Niudze's fields and houses be granted to Qincha Tai.

s0344.literal: Yesianier's troops reached Wu'an; Yesi Temür surrendered with his army; hearing this, Hedong prefectures and counties all killed the officials he had appointed.
s0344.idiomatic: Yesianier's troops reached Wu'an; Yesi Temür surrendered with his army; hearing this, Hedong prefectures and counties all killed the officials he had appointed.

s0345.literal: On guihai day the Emperor lodged at the fasting palace.
s0345.idiomatic: On guihai day the Emperor lodged at the fasting palace.

s0346.literal: On jiazi day wearing mourning robes and cap, he offered sacrifice at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
s0346.idiomatic: On jiazi day wearing mourning robes and cap, he offered sacrifice at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

s0347.literal: Shaanxi troops pressed toward Bianliang; hearing the court's proclamation to cease troops, they thereupon dispersed and withdrew.
s0347.idiomatic: Shaanxi troops pressed toward Bianliang; hearing the court's proclamation to cease troops, they thereupon dispersed and withdrew.

s0348.literal: On yichou day Yan Temür requested that the fields and houses of thirty persons including Ubaidullah be granted to thirty persons including Orus — approved.
s0348.idiomatic: On yichou day Yan Temür requested that the fields and houses of 30 persons including Ubaidullah be granted to 30 persons including Orus — approved.

s0349.literal: On dingmao day Bayan was additionally made commander-in-chief of the Loyal Support Guard.
s0349.idiomatic: On dingmao day Bayan was additionally made commander-in-chief of the Loyal Support Guard.

s0350.literal: On gengwu day the Chaghan Na'ur pacification commission was reestablished.
s0350.idiomatic: On gengwu day the Chaghan Na'ur pacification commission was reestablished.

s0351.literal: Commanders of all palace guard offices were ordered to separately select from recruited braves; those who had not formerly served in the palace guard were all dismissed.
s0351.idiomatic: Commanders of all palace guard offices were ordered to separately select from recruited braves; those who had not formerly served in the palace guard were all dismissed.

s0352.literal: Bianliang, Henan and other routes and Nanyang Prefecture, suffering consecutive years of locusts and drought — brewing liquor within their territories was forbidden.
s0352.idiomatic: Bianliang, Henan and other routes and Nanyang Prefecture, suffering consecutive years of locusts and drought — brewing liquor within their territories was forbidden.

s0353.literal: Japanese merchant ships trading at Fujian — Jiang-Zhe Branch Secretariat selected honest officials to collect their taxes.
s0353.idiomatic: Japanese merchant ships trading at Fujian — Jiang-Zhe Branch Secretariat selected honest officials to collect their taxes.

s0354.literal: Central secretariat officials said: "This year having already ceased printing note blocks, next year it is proposed to print one million one hundred ninety-two thousand ingots of Zhiyuan notes and forty thousand ingots of Zhongtong notes."
s0354.idiomatic: Central secretariat officials said: "This year having already ceased printing note blocks, next year it is proposed to print 1,192,000 ingots of Zhiyuan notes and 40,000 ingots of Zhongtong notes."

s0355.literal: Investigating censor said: "The Ministry of Revenue's note law — yearly accounting of the numbers, exchanging old for new, with the aim of circulation, not exceeding the quota.
s0355.idiomatic: Investigating censor said: "The Ministry of Revenue's note law — yearly accounting of the numbers, exchanging old for new, with the aim of circulation, not exceeding the quota.

s0356.literal: Recently Doresh, because Shangdu's expenses were insufficient, ordered the offices to carve blocks and print notes;
s0356.idiomatic: Recently Doresh, because Shangdu's expenses were insufficient, ordered the offices to carve blocks and print notes;

s0357.literal: Now that affairs are settled, they should urgently be collected and destroyed."
s0357.idiomatic: Now that affairs are settled, they should urgently be collected and destroyed."

s0359.literal: Investigating censors Saribuhua, Suonan Ba, Yu Qin, and Zhang Shihong said: "In court governance, rewards and punishments come first; when merit and guilt are clear, all under Heaven is thereby settled.
s0359.idiomatic: Investigating censors Saribuhua, Suonan Ba, Yu Qin, and Zhang Shihong said: "In court governance, rewards and punishments come first; when merit and guilt are clear, all under Heaven is thereby settled.

s0360.literal: In recent years the state, from Temuder's usurping position and monopolizing authority, used punishments and rewards to serve his private ends — discipline first became disordered.
s0360.idiomatic: In recent years the state, from Temuder's usurping position and monopolizing authority, used punishments and rewards to serve his private ends — discipline first became disordered.

s0361.literal: Reaching the Taiding reign, enfeoffments and rewards grew ever more excessive.
s0361.idiomatic: Reaching the Taiding reign, enfeoffments and rewards grew ever more excessive.

s0362.literal: Recently because warfare arose and employment of men was very urgent — yet rewards and punishments cannot but be strict.
s0362.idiomatic: Recently because warfare arose and employment of men was very urgent — yet rewards and punishments cannot but be strict.

s0363.literal: The height of merit and the weight of fault all depend on the public opinion of all under Heaven.
s0363.idiomatic: The height of merit and the weight of fault all depend on the public opinion of all under Heaven.

s0364.literal: We wish the relevant offices, in accordance with public deliberation, clearly show dismissals and promotions.
s0364.idiomatic: We wish the relevant offices, in accordance with public deliberation, clearly show dismissals and promotions.

s0365.literal: When merit and guilt are clear and rewards and punishments are appropriate, then the court is pure, discipline is restored, and all under Heaven is governed."
s0365.idiomatic: When merit and guilt are clear and rewards and punishments are appropriate, then the court is pure, discipline is restored, and all under Heaven is governed."

s0366.literal: The Emperor commended and accepted it.
s0366.idiomatic: The Emperor commended and accepted it.

s0367.literal: On xinwei day western monks were dispatched to perform Buddhist rites within Xinghe's inner precinct.
s0367.idiomatic: On xinwei day western monks were dispatched to perform Buddhist rites within Xinghe's inner precinct.

s0368.literal: Temürge's troops entered Xiangyang; this route's officials all fled.
s0368.idiomatic: Temürge's troops entered Xiangyang; this route's officials all fled.

s0369.literal: Xiangyang County magistrate Gu Tinggui and registrar Zhang De alone did not leave; western troops seized and ordered them to submit; they would not submit and were killed.
s0369.idiomatic: Xiangyang County magistrate Gu Tinggui and registrar Zhang De alone did not leave; western troops seized and ordered them to submit; they would not submit and were killed.

s0370.literal: At the time associate privy council administrator Taqai held troops at Nanyang and did not rescue.
s0370.idiomatic: At the time associate privy council administrator Taqai held troops at Nanyang and did not rescue.

s0371.literal: On renshen day officials were dispatched to announce sacrifices at the altars of soil and grain.
s0371.idiomatic: On renshen day officials were dispatched to announce sacrifices at the altars of soil and grain.

s0372.literal: Three hundred qing of fields at Pingjiang of former grand councillor Heilü and reed lands at Jiaxing were granted to Prince of Xi'an Alaqtenashiri.
s0372.idiomatic: 300 qing of fields at Pingjiang of former grand councillor Heilü and reed lands at Jiaxing were granted to Prince of Xi'an Alaqtenashiri.

s0373.literal: On guiyou day the eight hundred wives country envoy Zhao Ai, Yunnan Weichu Route native official Nifang and others, and ninety-nine stockade native officials including Biyegu each presented local products in tribute.
s0373.idiomatic: On guiyou day the eight hundred wives country envoy Zhao Ai, Yunnan Weichu Route native official Nifang and others, and 99 stockade native officials including Biyegu each presented local products in tribute.

s0374.literal: Yan Temür said: "Formerly when Shangdu raised troops, ten persons including Prince Siri and associate privy council administrator Aqila, facing south toward the palace shouted and clamored; their faction resisted orders and fought in rebellion — the sentiment cannot be pardoned."
s0374.idiomatic: Yan Temür said: "Formerly when Shangdu raised troops, ten persons including Prince Siri and associate privy council administrator Aqila, facing south toward the palace shouted and clamored; their faction resisted orders and fought in rebellion — the sentiment cannot be pardoned."

s0375.literal: An edict ordered each flogged one hundred seven strokes, exiled far, and their family property registered for confiscation.
s0375.idiomatic: An edict ordered each flogged 107 strokes, exiled far, and their family property registered for confiscation.

s0376.literal: On jiaxu day the Empress of Taiding's Onggirad clan was resettled at Dong'an Prefecture.
s0376.idiomatic: On jiaxu day the Empress of Taiding's Onggirad clan was resettled at Dong'an Prefecture.

s0377.literal: Hangzhou suffered fire; Jiang-Zhe Branch Secretariat was ordered to relieve disaster-struck households.
s0377.idiomatic: Hangzhou suffered fire; Jiang-Zhe Branch Secretariat was ordered to relieve disaster-struck households.

s0378.literal: On yihai day Prince of Xi'an Alaqtenashiri, Prince of Qi Yolqi Temür, and privy council administrator Buqa Temür were each granted five hundred taels of gold, two thousand five hundred taels of silver, and ten thousand ingots of notes; Prince Dor Temür fifty taels of gold, five hundred taels of silver, and one thousand ingots of notes; followers and soldiers according to difference.
s0378.idiomatic: On yihai day Prince of Xi'an Alaqtenashiri, Prince of Qi Yolqi Temür, and privy council administrator Buqa Temür were each granted 500 taels of gold, 2,500 taels of silver, and 10,000 ingots of notes; Prince Dor Temür 50 taels of gold, 500 taels of silver, and 1,000 ingots of notes; followers and soldiers according to difference.

s0379.literal: On bingzi day Susu, for accepting bribes, was flogged one hundred seven strokes and exiled to Xiangyang;
s0379.idiomatic: On bingzi day Susu, for accepting bribes, was flogged 107 strokes and exiled to Xiangyang;

s0380.literal: Because his mother was old, an edict ordered him kept at the capital.
s0380.idiomatic: Because his mother was old, an edict ordered him kept at the capital.

s0381.literal: On dingchou day, the rite of personally sacrificing at the Imperial Ancestral Temple having been completed, he presided at the Hall of Great Brightness and received homage from princes and civil and military officials.
s0381.idiomatic: On dingchou day, the rite of personally sacrificing at the Imperial Ancestral Temple having been completed, he presided at the Hall of Great Brightness and received homage from princes and civil and military officials.

s0382.literal: Prince of Jing Yesu Buqan dispatched an envoy with a proclamation to Xiangyang; Temürge led troops and fled.
s0382.idiomatic: Prince of Jing Yesu Buqan dispatched an envoy with a proclamation to Xiangyang; Temürge led troops and fled.

s0383.literal: On wuyin day surveillance vice censor Yuelu Buhua was made grand superintendent of imperial blessings.
s0383.idiomatic: On wuyin day surveillance vice censor Yuelu Buhua was made grand superintendent of imperial blessings.

s0384.literal: Investigating censors Saribuhua and others said: "Yuelu Buhua has always possessed upright spirit and proper conduct; if Your Majesty wishes to restore censorate authority, none but this man will suffice."
s0384.idiomatic: Investigating censors Saribuhua and others said: "Yuelu Buhua has always possessed upright spirit and proper conduct; if Your Majesty wishes to restore censorate authority, none but this man will suffice."

s0385.literal: Yuelu Buhua was thereupon again made vice censor-in-chief, concurrently grand superintendent of imperial blessings.
s0385.idiomatic: Yuelu Buhua was thereupon again made vice censor-in-chief, concurrently grand superintendent of imperial blessings.

s0386.literal: Buddhist rites were performed at Wutai Temple.
s0386.idiomatic: Buddhist rites were performed at Wutai Temple.

s0387.literal: Henan and Jiang-Zhe provinces were ordered to augment Huguang with fifty thousand troops.
s0387.idiomatic: Henan and Jiang-Zhe provinces were ordered to augment Huguang with 50,000 troops.

s0388.literal: On jimao day central secretariat officials said: "Inner and outer officials who reach retirement age should all receive commission edicts according to rank sequence; hereafter memorial need not be made."
s0388.idiomatic: On jimao day central secretariat officials said: "Inner and outer officials who reach retirement age should all receive commission edicts according to rank sequence; hereafter memorial need not be made."

s0390.literal: Pearl robes of Yesi Temür and Ubaidullah were granted to Sadi and Zhao Shi'an.
s0390.idiomatic: Pearl robes of Yesi Temür and Ubaidullah were granted to Sadi and Zhao Shi'an.

s0391.literal: Han troops of the various guards and able-bodied men of prefectures and counties to whom armor and weapons had been issued — all were ordered returned to the government.
s0391.idiomatic: Han troops of the various guards and able-bodied men of prefectures and counties to whom armor and weapons had been issued — all were ordered returned to the government.

s0392.literal: On gengchen day envoys were dispatched to respectfully welcome the imperial elder brother Emperor Mingzong from the northern desert.
s0392.idiomatic: On gengchen day envoys were dispatched to respectfully welcome the imperial elder brother Emperor Mingzong from the northern desert.

s0393.literal: Central Domestic Affairs Court commissioner Jingyan was made central secretariat grand councillor; associate privy council administrator Cheli Temür was made central secretariat left vice chancellor.
s0393.idiomatic: Central Domestic Affairs Court commissioner Jingyan was made central secretariat grand councillor; associate privy council administrator Cheli Temür was made central secretariat left vice chancellor.

s0394.literal: On xinsi day Qipchaq commanders of hundreds and their soldiers were sent back to garrison.
s0394.idiomatic: On xinsi day Qipchaq commanders of hundreds and their soldiers were sent back to garrison.

s0395.literal: The wives of Toqto and two others were granted to Kukuqu and two others; the fields and houses of eleven persons including Duotai were granted to imperial son-in-law Dobir and eleven others.
s0395.idiomatic: The wives of Toqto and two others were granted to Kukuqu and two others; the fields and houses of 11 persons including Duotai were granted to imperial son-in-law Dobir and 11 others.

s0396.literal: On renyang day the third prince Baoning was renamed Taipingne; the grand minister of agriculture Maizhu was ordered to nurture him in his household.
s0396.idiomatic: On renyang day the third prince Baoning was renamed Taipingne; the grand minister of agriculture Maizhu was ordered to nurture him in his household.

s0397.literal: An edict ordered the mobile privy council to cease troops and return.
s0397.idiomatic: An edict ordered the mobile privy council to cease troops and return.

s0398.literal: Surveillance vice censor Yuelu Buhua was made central secretariat right vice chancellor.
s0398.idiomatic: Surveillance vice censor Yuelu Buhua was made central secretariat right vice chancellor.

s0399.literal: On guimao day Doresh was executed by beheading; his corpse was dismembered and displayed in the marketplace; Wang Chan was also granted death; Ma Mou, Niudze, Sadirishi, Yesi Temür and others were all displayed and executed in the marketplace.
s0399.idiomatic: On guimao day Doresh was executed by beheading; his corpse was dismembered and displayed in the marketplace; Wang Chan was also granted death; Ma Mou, Niudze, Sadirishi, Yesi Temür and others were all displayed and executed in the marketplace.

s0400.literal: The residences granted to Susu and Yesianier were transferred and granted to imperial son-in-law Jinzhir and wet nurse Yesunjin.
s0400.idiomatic: The residences granted to Susu and Yesianier were transferred and granted to imperial son-in-law Jinzhir and wet nurse Yesunjin.
